info.description: The Cross Channel Contact Routing API facilitates the retrieval of contact routing information based on specific parameters. It allows users to access cross-channel communication routes, thereby optimizing customer interactions across various platforms. This API is particularly useful for customer service applications, where businesses aim to streamline contact routing for enhanced user experience. Typical consumers include customer support teams and marketing departments seeking to improve engagement with clients through efficient routing strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve contact routing details by resource ID.
get.description: This endpoint fetches the contact routing information associated with a specific resource ID. It allows users to access important contact routing data necessary for cross-channel communications, ensuring efficient management and directing of messages.
